subject: Finlytics renewal: workload review, pilot proposal, and timeline
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@finlytics.ai>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Recap: today’s renewal call — usage, pain, and proposed next steps

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call so everyone has the same view and we can move to a pilot kickoff quickly.

Summary of what we heard
- Primary pain: unpredictable tail-latency on peak risk-scoring requests during market open windows, which is adding back-pressure to Tom’s ingestion pipeline.
- Growth signal: embeddings calls and real-time scoring increased ~3x during Nov–Dec (see attached usage CSV).
- Goal: lock a renewal that covers current usage with headroom for the new real-time workload, plus a 60-day Dedicated pilot to validate latency SLOs.

Proposed short-term path (next 30 days)
1) Pilot scope: Dedicated pool (2x A100 equivalent) + KV caching for scoring prefixes — 60 days. We’ll run a benchmark week 1 and 1-week production validation week 5.
2) Pricing: rough ranges below (detailed quote after we confirm pilot config):
   - Dedicated pilot (2 GPUs, burst cap): $28k–$36k / month (pilot discounted)
   - Post-pilot committed capacity (monthly commitment): TBD based on observed QPS and cache hit rates
3) Timeline: pilot kickoff target week of Jan 20; decision on renewal/commercial terms by Feb 28.

Immediate asks for Finlytics
- Confirm high-level pilot acceptance and any non-negotiable compliance items (SOC2 / IP restrictions) by end of week 1.
- Share any peak-window logs (sample) for the Jan–Dec 2026 period if available — helps sizing.

Attachments: finlytics_usage_nov_dec2026.csv (exported usage), redwood_pilot_scope_v1.pdf (pilot scope stub).

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 09:01:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap: today’s renewal call — usage, pain, and proposed next steps

Appreciate the concise rundown, Sean — this matches what we discussed. A couple clarifications from our side:
- Workloads to validate in the pilot:
  * Real-time risk scoring (latency sensitive, spikes at market open ~08:30–09:30 ET)
  * Embeddings for model matching (high QPS but tolerant to a 50–100ms tail)
- Compliance: SOC2 is required; we’ll need the attestation and an evidence pack for our procurement review.
- Procurement ask: can you include both Dedicated (redwood-managed) and a Private (VPC) option in the commercial so we can compare TCO?

Next steps for us: I’ll surface the pilot ask to procurement and legal this week and get back if there are any mandatory contract redlines. If possible, we’d like an initial commercial range by EOD Friday so procurement has numbers to work with.

Diane Park
Head of Platform Engineering | Finlytics
diane.park@finlytics.ai | +1 212-555-0420

Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 17:34:00 -0500
Subject: Pricing ranges + pilot doc — follow-up

Diane / Tom —
Attaching a short pilot scope (redwood_pilot_scope_v1.pdf) and a preliminary commercial range so procurement has something to evaluate quickly. These are ranges only; final pricing will depend on pilot telemetry and exact burst/commit sizing.

Prelim pricing ranges (for procurement planning)
- Dedicated pilot (2x A100 equivalent, 60 days, pilot discount): $26,000 – $34,000 / month (pilot billing prorated for 60 days)
- Post-pilot committed monthly: starting $42,000 / month for a 6–12 month commit (estimates depend on average QPS and cache hits)
- Private deployment option (VPC, customer-managed infra): variable — we can provide an SOW for on-prem support and an estimated ops fee; usually higher up-front but lower unit price depending on infra choices.

Proposed checklist / next milestones
- You: confirm pilot acceptance and procurement timeline by Fri, Jan 8 (we’ll prepare a short SOW and pilot MOU).
- Us: share SOC 2 attestation and evidence pack (I’ll loop security) — expect by Jan 10.
- Schedule: target pilot kickoff week of Jan 20 — I’ve blocked 90 minutes for a kickoff (tech + CS) on Jan 20; will send a calendar invite if that date works.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FIN-2027-001 (internal).

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: redwood_pilot_scope_v1.pdf (stub).

Looping in operational readiness notes from CS. Quick internal checklist before pilot kickoff:
- CS owners: Lauren (tech lead) + Priya Natarajan (onboarding SME) — will prep runbook and rollout playbook.
- Benchmarks we want in week 1: p50/p95/p99 latency for scoring under 1k, 5k, 10k QPS; cache hit rate targets.
- Validation window: schedule a 7-day production validation after configuration (week 5 of pilot).
- Docs to prepare: pilot runbook, acceptance criteria, rollback plan. I’ll draft and share by Jan 14.

If Sean confirms the Jan 20 kickoff block I’ll send a calendar invite for the technical kickoff and pre-kickoff scoping session.
